given: The team member is on the file-stock screen with an otherwise valid sku, location, and inventory_code
when: They submit a filing whose quantity is negative
then: The filing is rejected with an inline error that names the quantity field (e.g. "quantity must be >= 0") rather than a generic 400 body, and no negative stock record is stored
architectural_notes: Validation-failure path owned at the app/routes boundary: it returns a field-named inline error surfaced next to the quantity field (NFR-F1-field-named-validation), never a bare 400. The non-negative floor is also defended in depth by CHECK quantity >= 0 (PI3, NFR-F1-quantity-integrity) so no negative row is ever persisted. Asserted end to end (rejected submit + branch DB state), so E2E.

independence.rationale: Asserts the validation-failure path for a negative quantity (field-named inline error, no negative row stored), distinct from AC1-AC4 which cover only valid filings; a build could accept every valid filing yet return a bare 400 or store a negative quantity on invalid input.
